response.overview: The filmmakers present the stories of ordinary people across three segments of this anthology film: "Trust," "Frenzy," and "Conscience." The lives of the protagonists have been ruthlessly ground down by a modern-day scourge: fraud. Much is said and written today about the complex world of information technology and the importance of protecting oneself and one’s loved ones. Yet, not everyone possesses the caution, skepticism, wariness, and high level of awareness needed to stay safe; consequently, people of all ages and social backgrounds fall prey to scammers.
